name: Protein Berry Overnight Oats
method: Mix everything in a container, refrigerate overnight, and stir before serving.

name: Banana Protein Porridge
method: Cook oats with milk until creamy. Stir in protein powder off the heat and top with banana and cinnamon.

name: Protein Eggs on Wholemeal Toast
method: Scramble or fry the eggs. Toast the bread and serve with tomato and wilted spinach.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Bowl
method: Combine yoghurt and berries. Top with oats and chia seeds.

name: Cottage Cheese Banana Bowl
method: Slice the banana and combine with cottage cheese and cinnamon.

name: Protein Banana Pancakes
method: Blend ingredients into a batter. Cook small pancakes in a non-stick pan until set on both sides.

name: Chicken Breakfast Wrap
method: Cook diced chicken. Scramble the eggs with spinach, then fill the wrap with chicken, egg and tomato.

name: Cottage Cheese Protein Toast
method: Toast bread and top with cottage cheese, sliced tomato and pepper.

name: Chicken & Broccoli Rice Bowl
method: Cook rice. Pan-cook chicken until fully cooked, steam broccoli, then combine with soy sauce and olive oil.

name: Chicken Fajita Rice Bowl
method: Cook rice. Fry sliced chicken, peppers and onion with fajita seasoning. Serve over rice with yoghurt.

name: Tuna Protein Pasta
method: Boil pasta. Drain tuna and combine with yoghurt, sweetcorn and spinach; fold through warm pasta.

name: Lean Beef & Pepper Rice Bowl
method: Brown beef with onion and peppers. Add passata and simmer. Serve with cooked rice.

name: Creamy Chicken Spinach Pasta
method: Boil pasta. Cook chicken and garlic, wilt spinach, then lower heat and stir in yoghurt. Toss with pasta.

name: Tuna Jacket Potato
method: Bake or microwave the potato until tender. Mix tuna, cottage cheese and sweetcorn and spoon over the potato.

name: High Protein Chicken Salad
method: Cook chicken and slice. Toss salad vegetables and top with chicken and olive oil dressing.

name: Turkey Salad Wrap
method: Cook turkey mince with seasoning. Fill the wrap with turkey, salad and yoghurt.

name: Chicken Curry & Rice
method: Cook rice. Fry chicken and onion with curry powder, add tomatoes and vegetables, simmer until chicken is cooked, then finish with yoghurt.

name: Lean Beef Chilli & Potato
method: Brown beef with onion and peppers. Add tomatoes and beans and simmer. Serve with baked or boiled potato.

name: Lean Beef Tomato Pasta
method: Brown beef and onion. Add passata and simmer. Cook pasta, wilt spinach into the sauce and combine.

name: Chicken Tikka & Rice
method: Marinate chicken in yoghurt and spices. Cook chicken thoroughly, simmer with tomato and onion, and serve with rice.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl
method: Cook rice. Stir-fry chicken and vegetables until cooked, add teriyaki sauce and toss. Serve over rice.

name: Honey Soy Chicken & Broccoli
method: Cook rice. Stir-fry chicken and broccoli, then add soy sauce and honey. Toss until glossy.

name: Salmon & Roasted Potatoes
method: Roast potatoes with oil. Add salmon and broccoli near the end and cook until salmon is opaque and flakes easily.

name: Garlic Prawn Tomato Pasta
method: Cook pasta. Sauté prawns and garlic, add passata and spinach, then toss with pasta.

name: Turkey & Bean Chilli
method: Brown turkey with onion and peppers. Add tomatoes and beans and simmer until thick.

name: Chicken Vegetable Noodles
method: Cook noodles. Stir-fry chicken and vegetables, add soy sauce and toss through noodles.

name: Lean Beef Stir-Fry Noodles
method: Brown beef, add vegetables and cook until tender-crisp. Toss with noodles and soy sauce.

name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
method: Cook rice and chicken. Assemble with beans, sweetcorn, tomato and yoghurt.

name: Chicken Pesto Pasta
method: Cook pasta and chicken. Toss with pesto, spinach and tomato while warm.

name: Tuna Tomato Pasta Bake
method: Cook pasta and combine with tuna, passata and spinach. Top with cheese and bake until bubbling.

name: High Protein Egg Fried Rice
method: Use cooked chilled rice. Stir-fry vegetables, add rice, then push aside and scramble eggs before combining with soy sauce.

name: Red Lentil Curry & Rice
method: Simmer lentils with tomatoes, onion and spices until tender. Stir in spinach and serve with rice.

name: Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry
method: Brown tofu, stir-fry vegetables, add soy sauce and serve over rice.

name: Halloumi & Couscous Bowl
method: Prepare couscous. Pan-sear halloumi and assemble with chopped vegetables and spinach.

name: Mediterranean Bean Pasta
method: Cook pasta. Simmer beans, passata and spinach, then toss with pasta and olive oil.

name: Chicken Vegetable Soup
method: Simmer vegetables in stock until tender. Add diced chicken and cook through. Season to taste.

name: Lean Beef Vegetable Soup
method: Brown beef, add vegetables and stock, then simmer until vegetables are tender.

name: Tuna Sweetcorn Salad
method: Mix tuna, sweetcorn and yoghurt. Serve over salad and tomato.

name: Egg & Cottage Cheese Salad
method: Boil eggs, cool and slice. Serve with cottage cheese and salad.

name: Chicken & Potato Meal Prep
method: Roast potato and broccoli. Cook chicken separately until fully cooked, then portion together.

name: Lean Beef Loaded Potato
method: Bake potato. Brown beef with seasoning and serve with cottage cheese and tomato.

name: Prawn & Vegetable Rice Bowl
method: Cook rice. Stir-fry prawns and vegetables, add soy sauce and serve over rice.

name: Salmon Rice Bowl
method: Cook rice and salmon. Serve with cucumber, broccoli and soy sauce.

name: Protein Berry Yogurt Pot
method: Stir protein powder through yoghurt and top with berries.

name: Cottage Cheese Berry Bowl
method: Combine cottage cheese and berries.

name: Chocolate Protein Yogurt
method: Mix until smooth and chill for a thicker texture.

name: Boiled Eggs & Tomato
method: Boil eggs to preference, cool and serve with tomato.

name: Banana Protein Yogurt
method: Slice banana and combine with yoghurt and cinnamon.

name: Tuna Cucumber Cups
method: Mix tuna with yoghurt and spoon into cucumber slices.
